'''Lake Brell''', also known as '''Brell Lake''', was a [[lake]] on the ruined [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The acid lake formed over the ruins of [[Fellwater Labs]], a laboratory that was destroyed in the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment of the planet]], and its [[Water/Legends|waters]] were a sickly green [[Color/Legends|color]]. The biological experiment known as [[Subject Alpha]] roamed the lake around [[3643 BBY]], and a group of Republic colonists built a colony within a bunker on the shore.
